Question: Assalamoalikum Please throw some light on Ghair Muqallids. They are misguiding many muslims through their books. If there is any book or any literature on Ghair Muqallid ,about their belief .What are their common questions and their answers? JazakALLAH Answer ID: 1309 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 372/372=L) In order to know their beliefs and to know the refutation of their claims, please go through the below mentioned books: Muhazraat Radd-e-Ghiar Muqallidiyat: Mufti Muhammad Rashid, Adilla-e-Kamilah, Tajalliyat-e-Safdar, Tuhfa-e-Ahl Hadith, Hadya-e-Ahl Hadith, Mutala-e-Ghiar Muqallidiyat, Hadith Ahl Hadith, Majmua-e-Rasail-o-Maqalaat, Futoohaat-e-Safdar etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
